documented.audit-report.md: Scope, coverage, findings, detailed tickets, limitations and next actions.
documented.results.json: Authoritative cases, steps, attempts, tickets, evidence and computed summary.
documented.tickets.csv: Triage and import export derived from results.json.
documented.evidence/: Only collected, registered evidence with portable relative paths.

scope_limits.installation: The available-skills entry and all listed resources were accessible.
scope_limits.resolution: The installed skill directory is a symlink to the supplied project skill directory.
scope_limits.documented_workflow: Establish scope and capabilities; validate configuration and plan explicit cases; execute with evidence; triage defects into tickets; validate coherent exports; retest in a new campaign while preserving history.
skill_boundaries: Functional acceptance, multilingual checks and evidence-backed defect reporting.
Translation-only work, complete SEO audits, penetration tests and legal certification require different workflows.
Accessibility observations do not certify conformance; performance and regulatory work require explicit scope.
Missing capabilities require BLOCKED or NOT_RUN outcomes; zero executed checks cannot approve a site.
Geography requires network-country evidence from the same request context.
Automatic export headings support English and French; narrative translation remains separate.
External ticket publication requires an explicit request.
scope_limits.check_boundaries: Local instruction and resource reads only. No websites browsed, files written, software installed, tests or helper scripts executed, or work delegated. Runtime capabilities and schema validity were not verified.

limitation: This checks explicit invocation and resource access, not implicit selection or browser behavior.
